storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP SexChatHU Downloader makes it easy to save live streams and recordings from SexChatHU to your computer.

How it works: Go to any model page on SexChatHU, and either click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the stream using the site's API, shows available quality options, and lets you start a live capture or download a recording as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming, CDN host probing, and Mouflon URI decryption automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized SEXCHATHU subfolder.

Key features:
- API-driven stream detection (room list + chat API + CDN probing)
- Live capture with start/stop controls — record as long as you want
- VR stream support with camera metadata preservation
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Dark-themed UI with rose/pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to SexChatHU and open a model's page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and start capturing — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model's page on SexChatHU while they are live. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon. Select your quality and click Start. Click Stop when you want to finish — the stream saves as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos (VOD)?
faq.answer: Yes — navigate to a model's video page and the extension will detect the recording. Select quality and click Download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the HLS master playlist — typically multiple resolutions. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Does it support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes — VR streams are detected automatically with camera metadata (stereoPacking, frameFormat, angle). The VR info is shown in the UI and appended to the filename.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a SEXCHATHU subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is currently live and streaming publicly. If the model is offline or in a private show, the extension will display a status message. Refresh the page if issues persist.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
